Create a production animation sprite sheet on true transparent alpha, 1536x1024 landscape, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows equal cells. Six entire book creatures, one per cell, no labels or borders. Preserve purple cover, yellow gold rounded corner plates and spine bands, cream page-teeth, red forked bookmark tongue, large angry eyes. Simple rounded Duolingo-like game illustration matching reference. Enemy faces LEFT in slight three-quarter view, spine on RIGHT and biting mouth opening toward LEFT. Top row: idle mouth slightly open; anticipation upper cover lifted high ready to bite; attack jaws nearly clamped, tongue darting left. No limbs, no particles, no shadows, no glow, no background, no text. Spine MUST physically join upper and lower covers in all six poses. Entire tongue and every corner within each cell, broad 50px padding. Same book dimensions and scale across panels, consistent lower cover center at each cell's x center and common baseline, action differs by jaws and expression. No detached covers. Clean crisp opaque shapes and real transparent surroundings.
